=== REMEDIATION VALIDATED + PROCESS BUG FILED (final) ===

Epic 1386 re-review after remediation: PASS, 0 blocking, 11 advisory; fresh attestation signed at sha 2281280d. FILED BUG e7be-b985-c344-46f7 (creamy-cocksure-elkhound): 'Plan review certified an epic whose acceptance criteria were mutually unsatisfiable'. Linked discovered_from 1386, relates_to 35bc and 2aa6. Gates: check-ac pass (6 criteria), clarity 7/5 pass, quality pass.

The bug records SEVEN unsatisfiable criteria across epic 1386, 35bc and 2aa6 - all of which PASSED plan review with 0 blocking (epic manifest: plan-review PASS / blocking 0 / advisory 11) - in four classes:
- A: an AC contradicting its own ticket's Scope or a sibling AC IN THE SAME DOCUMENT. Sharpest example: 2aa6 AC1 demanded zero SC matches across src/rebar/llm/reviewers/ while its own AC6 demanded exactly one match in plan_review_T2.md inside that directory.
- B: an AC contradicting a mechanical property of a generated artifact. Epic AC5 required the criteria guide be regenerated from the registry AND contain no SC vocabulary, when the registry contains the excluded T2 prompt.
- C: an AC hard-coding a count (epic AC4 'the 108 store tickets') that the plan elsewhere says to recompute; actual was 106.
- D: a parent AC covered by NO child (llm/completion.py:288). Recorded as an observation: criterion G3 exists precisely to check 'the union of children covers each parent acceptance/success criterion', routes at container scope, ran, and did not flag it.

Also recorded: the reviewer DID block 2aa6 on re-review for a stale cross-ticket factual claim (asserting 1f32 had not merged when it had), so cross-ticket fact-checking fires; the seven failures are the different, internal-consistency class. And the cost framing: plan review certifies plans the completion verifier later refuses, so the disagreement surfaces after the code is written, reviewed and in two cases already merged, with every correction forcing a full LLM re-review via stale-material.

Per operator instruction the bug records evidence ONLY and does not diagnose the plan-review process; a follow-up session owns that.
